items.quote: 6:10 And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying, 6:11 Go in, speak unto Pharaoh king of Egypt, that he let the children of Israel go out of his land.
items.claim: The text says the LORD told Moses to go to Pharaoh, king of Egypt, and ask him to let the children of Israel leave his land. This is what the text reports, not a confirmed historical event.
items.action: commanded Moses to speak to Pharaoh demanding release of the children of Israel
items.object: Pharaoh king of Egypt; the children of Israel
items.mechanism: divine command passed on through Moses to the Egyptian king
